cache_dir.description: The location of the local cache/working directory.

log_dir.description: The directory to use for apt-cacher access and error logs.

admin_email.description: Email address of the administrator displayed in info page and reports.

daemon_port.description: Port for standalone daemon mode. Must be root to use <1024.

daemon_group.description: Group to run the daemon as.

daemon_user.description: User to run the daemon as.

daemon_addr.description: IP address to bind the daemon to. Empty means all interfaces.

offline_mode.description: Set to 1 to operate in offline mode (no outgoing connections).

checksum.description: Set to 1 to enable checksum database (requires libberkeleydb-perl).

concurrent_import_limit.description: Limit on concurrent import of checksums (0 = no limit).

cgi_advise_to_use.default: Please use http://cacheserver:3142/ as apt-cacher access URL
cgi_advise_to_use.description: Message to show on CGI access (deprecated).

cgi_advise_to_use_2.default: Server relocated. To change sources.list, run perl -pe "s,/apt-cacher??,:3142," -i /etc/apt/sources.list

cgi_redirect.description: Redirect URL for CGI requests to daemon mode.

http_proxy.description: External HTTP proxy for upstream connections.

interface.description: Network interface, IP, or hostname for upstream connections.

limit.description: Max bandwidth (bytes/sec) for fetching packages; 0 = unlimited.

path_map.default: debian ftp.uni-kl.de/pub/linux/debian ftp2.de.debian.org/debian ; ubuntu archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu ; security security.debian.org/debian-security ftp2.de.debian.org/debian-security
path_map.description: URL-to-server path mappings (space-separated lists, semicolon-separated rules).

path_map_debian_changelogs_override.description: Override for internal Debian changelog path mapping (empty to remove).

distinct_namespaces.description: Set to 1 to enable separate namespaces per distribution.

allowed_hosts.description: Comma-separated list of allowed IPs/hosts (including IPv6). '*' = allow all.

allowed_ssl_locations.description: Comma-separated list of allowed SSL upstream hosts/IPs.

allowed_ssl_ports.description: Comma-separated list of allowed SSL ports (dangerous to modify).

allowed_locations.description: List of allowed upstream server hostnames.
